response.sql:
WITH per_rating AS (
  SELECT rating, AVG(rental_rate / NULLIF(rental_duration, 0)) AS avg_rate_per_day
  FROM film
  WHERE replacement_cost <= 20.99
  GROUP BY rating
), overall AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_rate_per_day) AS overall_mean
  FROM per_rating
)
SELECT p.rating,
       p.avg_rate_per_day AS average,
       p.avg_rate_per_day - o.overall_mean AS difference_from_overall_mean
FROM per_rating p
CROSS JOIN overall o
WHERE o.overall_mean IS NOT NULL
  AND p.avg_rate_per_day > o.overall_mean;

assumptions.assumption: The cutoff selects films with replacement_cost at or below 20.99. Missing values are ignored by AVG; NULLIF also prevents division by zero if rental_duration is zero.
